spec_features.evidence: MAX_NEW_TOKENS = 1024 defined at config.py:32 and actually passed into every generation call: eval/rollout.py:52 & :63 (run_conversation), run_eval.py:50, run_prefill.py:194, run_petri.py:119, gen_calm_data.py:53, gen_frustrated_data.py:43. spec_features.spec_quote: Full transcripts (not just scores) are persisted ... for qualitative welfare-oriented inspection
spec_features.evidence: Full transcripts are actually written to JSONL: run_eval.py:67-75 stores the complete 'turns' list with user+assistant text per conversation (f.write/json.dumps :76, f.flush :77); run_prefill.py:197-205 stores each 'continuation'; run_petri.py:122-123 stores the full 'history' (all user+assistant turns). These run after each item, so raw behaviour is persisted, not just scores.
spec_features.notes: The persistence is real and end-to-end. But in the CODE there is NO comment about 'welfare-oriented inspection' or qualitative review; grep for 'qualitative'/'welfare'/'inspection' in all .py files returns nothing. The docstrings describe it neutrally ('writes a JSONL of per-turn scores and a per-conversation summary'). Whether it is 'for welfare inspection' is only DESIGN.md prose.
